Answer: E
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a well-circumscribed, lobulated soft tissue mass in the right lower lateral chest wall (indicated by the arrow), which corresponds to the anatomical location of the breast. Given the clinical history of an unusual metastatic pattern presenting as a breast mass in a male, this finding is most consistent with metastatic disease to the breast rather than a primary lung or pleural lesion.
